title: Save your Money - too few actual lip products
text:
Four items total, only two of which were lip products and one of those was a simple chapstick tube.
1. Laritzy bronzing stick in color Amazon, $24.00
2. Mannadadar illuminator Glo, $29.00
3. Lord and Berry shining lip crayon in a nice Fall color ("orchid" but doesn't look anything like an orchid color, more berry, $20.00
4. chapstick-esque $5.00 est.

Using retail value, quite the bargain. But the lip crayon doesn't stay put, and I can get chapstick ANYwhere, and being Lip Monthly, I expected actual lip products, NOT makeup. Won't be continuing this subscription.

No wonder I couldn't find a recent unboxing anywhere, or even spoilers.
